MCPECHO-SONG_OF_THE_ORACLES.title: Song of the Reaps
MCPECHO-SONG_OF_THE_ORACLES.pages.INITIA: As you journey onward, you enter a room and notice an intriguing altar. The altar bears strange symbols and radiates pulsating energy. On its surface, two scythes appear: one glowing white with serenity, the other shrouded in shadows. Whispers fill your mind: [blue][sine]Which path will you choose?[/sine][/blue]
The light reap connects with you, shining with radiance. You feel a protective energy, but notice that your power feels limited.
MCPECHO-SONG_OF_THE_ORACLES.pages.INITIA: Your Max HP is too low.
The dark reap connects with you, surrounded by shadows. You feel unlimited power, but begin to bear the weight of an uncontrollable energy.
MCPECHO-SONG_OF_THE_ORACLES.pages.BOTH.d: You feel both peace and destruction within you, but maintaining this balance requires great effort.
